description: neroAacEnc (Nero AAC Codec) 1.5.4.0: neroAacEnc -q 0.5 on a 22050 Hz source, on the synthetic source music-22k-stereo.wav.

input.name: music-22k-stereo.wav
input.generator: sources/make_sources.py of the sample kit (written from nothing, reproducible byte for byte)

selected_for: variable bitrate at 22.05 kHz, the profile the encoder chose
